## The question

[Tikz: Placing connecting Labels](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/733308/tikz-placing-connecting-labels), asked by [David Collins](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/111823/david-collins) on TeX Stack Exchange (2024-12-21; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> I'm building a tree n Tikz.  When I assign a label and arrow to show the relationship between two nodes, the label & arrow does not align with the line connecting the two nodes.
> ```latex
> \documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
>
> \tikzset{
>   every node/.style={   align=center}
> }
>
> \begin{document}
> \begin{tikzpicture}
> \tikzstyle{level 1}=[sibling distance=25mm]
> 	\node[ rectangle, draw, color=red] (MD) {Title}
> 		[child anchor=north]	
> 		child  {node (Inv) {SubTitle}  }
> 		child  {node (Sel) {SecTitle}  };
> \draw[<->, thick, blue] (MD) -- node[above, sloped] {abcde} +(Inv);
> \end{tikzpicture}
> \end{document}
> ```
> My output:
> [![enter image description here][q-1]][q-1]
> Any suggestions, please?
>
> This was the only search return that was close but didn't have the original lines to align with:
> https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/720004/enhancing-line-connections-and-text-alignment-in-tikz-diagram
>
>
>
>   [q-1]: MB5m2sUp.png
:::

The key `child anchor=north` that you set draws edges “to” the north anchor point of the child nodes. If you change

```latex
\draw[<->, thick, blue] (MD) -- node[above, sloped] {abcde} +(Inv);
```

to

```latex
\draw[<->, thick, blue] (MD) -- node[above, sloped] {abcde} +(Inv.north);
```

the two lines will match up.
